notes.title: Demo V1.5 - The Console Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712335/e7d71921a8cd229979ade9aaae69fcd7c594b6fb.png

Following our announcement of the Kickstarter last week, we promised an update to the Demo and here it is, available for Windows and Mac.

Become a staff member of The Cerpan Project in The Console and explore the conversations, documentation and secrets. However, the database has been hacked and the files are corrupted. Will you be able to discover what is going on?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712335/36bd03a27e3fc472b87b80bc42e525e9fa8bc36b.png

The Console is a new mode in the main menu. It is our experiment to share the lore and stories beyond the main story of the game.

notes.title: The Kickstarter Demo update
notes.content:
It has begun! The Kickstarter pre-launch is up for you all to follow.

It has been a Christmas full of writing, organizing and preparing content for you all. There are a few things that need to be done before launch but we are almost there. For now we want to start building the hype and to do so, besides the usual friendly spam on social networks, we have prepared a surprise. 

Next week we will upload a new version of the Demo with New Content!!! A new mode for the game called The Console that can be found in the Main Menu. It is our experimental way to share the lore and stories within the world of The Cerpan Project. Now the twist is that it is not handled directly to you, you will have to solve the puzzle by becoming a staff member of the Cerpan Project facility and discover what is going on.
